description: Abwasserbehandlungsanlagen im Landkreis Vorpommern-Rügen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The data collection contains the locations of the public wastewater treatment plants in the Vorpommern-Rügen district with information on the name, water law permit, the degree of treatment, the process, the responsibility and the type of wastewater. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Wastewater treatment plants in the district of Vorpommern-Rügen" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspireidentifiziert, Vorpommern-Rügen, Kläranlagen, Abwasserbehandlungsanlagen. The listing shows 2023-07-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
